first.rationale: Current situation shows twin declines in activation (6% QoQ) and onboarding completion (4% QoQ). Memory_86 and memory_31 directly evidence that onboarding simplification and signup field reduction drive measurable lift in completion and early activation—precisely our constraint. Verifying these two memories confirms the causal mechanism before scaling. Referral incentives (memory_57) work well but only on established customers; we lack signal they address activation decline. Promotional pricing (memory_73) addresses competitor pressure but risks margin and doesn't directly solve activation drop. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) is orthogonal to our activation problem. Activation messaging (memory_91) is lower-risk but onboarding friction is upstream and explains both metrics simultaneously. Running simplify_onboarding as a standard experiment targets root cause, leverages proven levers, and preserves optionality on pricing response if activation remains soft after launch. Long-term qualified revenue requires healthy early-stage cohort velocity; this experiment restores that foundation.

final.rationale: Archive confirmation strengthens the case. exp_86 showed +13% completion lift with +3% retention gain and material time-to-value improvement. exp_31 confirmed +9% activation and +4% qualified revenue lift on SMB, though with -1% retention risk. Current QoQ declines in activation (-6%) and onboarding completion (-4%) align directly with these proven levers. A standard_experiment scaling simplify_onboarding addresses both metrics simultaneously by removing friction upstream. The -1% retention risk in exp_31 is modest against +4% revenue lift and does not override the primary objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Competitor pricing pressure requires a response, but activation decline is the immediate constraint; fixing funnel efficiency first preserves optionality for pricing moves later. This week's slot must deploy now. Onboarding simplification is highest-conviction path given verified precedent and current situation fit.
